about: The guitar chord shapes unstrung ships, read by scripts/build-chord-library.mjs. Edited here, never in chord-library.json. See scripts/chord-library/README.md.
format: frets: string 6 first, -1 not played, 0 open, otherwise the fret. fingers: 1 index to 4 little, 0 for none; no thumb. barres: the frets held by a barre. from: where the shape came from. id: its id there. forkId: on one of ours, the fork voicing it stands in for.
